scripts.prisma:generate: cd ../.. && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://irp:irp@localhost:5432/irp} pnpm exec prisma validate --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: cd ../.. && PRISMA_GENERATE_SKIP_AUTOINSTALL=1 pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate:reset: cd ../.. && PRISMA_GENERATE_SKIP_AUTOINSTALL=1 pnpm exec prisma migrate reset --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
